column5: Saving a payout method returns an error
column6: Saving a payout (withdrawal) method returns an error.
column7:
1. Log in as a driver
2. Go to Payouts / Withdrawal Methods
3. Add a payout method and tap Save
column8: The payout method should be saved successfully.
column9: An error is returned and the method is not saved.

column5: Admin Panel settings do not save
column6: Changes made in Admin Panel settings are not saved when applied.
column7:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel
2. Change a value in Settings
3. Click Save / Apply
4. Reload the page
column8: Settings should be saved and persist after reload.
column9: The settings are not saved.

column5: Ride numbers use the old "RR" prefix and include the year
column6: Ride numbers use the old "RR" prefix and include "2026".
column7:
1. Create a ride
2. Check the ride number in the Rider App, Driver App and Admin Panel
column8: Ride numbers should use "ISU" without the year (e.g. ISU-00253).
column9: Ride numbers show "RR" with the year.

column5: Points are not credited after rides, parcels or referrals
column6: No points are added after completed rides, parcel deliveries or referrals.
column7:
1. Complete a ride and a parcel delivery, and refer a new user
2. Check the rider's points balance
column8: 5 points per ride, 5 per parcel delivery, 5 per referral, 10 bonus on joining; points usable for trips at 5 points = $1.
column9: No points are added.

column5: Ride numbers not updated in the Admin Panel
column6: The Admin Panel still shows ride numbers in the old format.
column7:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel
2. Open the trips list and a trip detail
3. Check the ride number format
column8: Ride numbers should use the new format (e.g. ISU-00253).
column9: Old-format ride numbers are shown.

column5: Wallet top-up notification in a foreign language, amount missing "$"
column6: The wallet top-up notification is in a foreign language and the amount has no "$" before it.
column7:
1. Top up a user's wallet from the Admin Panel
2. Check the notification in the app
column8: English text with "$" before the amount, e.g. "Your wallet has just been topped up $2000 by admin".
column9: Foreign-language text without "$".

column5: Payment methods selected in the Admin Panel are not applied in the apps
column6: Payment method settings in the Admin Panel are not reflected in the apps; Cash is still offered when only Wallet and Card are selected.
column7:
1. In the Admin Panel, enable only Wallet and Card
2. Book a ride in the Rider App
3. Check the available payment methods
column8: Apps should show only the methods enabled in the Admin Panel.
column9: Cash is still available.

column5: Google Cloud project name not changed to iSERVU
column6: The Google Cloud project name has not been changed to iSERVU.
column7:
1. Check the project name in Google Cloud Console
2. Use Google Sign-In in the app and check the app name on the consent screen
column8: The Google project name should be "iSERVU".
column9: The old project name is shown.

column5: Parcel pricing not linked to the Admin Panel; wrong price on Android
column6: Parcel pricing is not connected to Admin Panel settings, and the Android Rider App shows wrong parcel prices.
column7:
1. Set parcel pricing in the Admin Panel
2. Create a parcel request in the Android Rider App
3. Compare the price shown
column8: Parcel prices should be calculated from Admin Panel pricing on every platform.
column9: The Android Rider App shows wrong parcel pricing.

column5: SOS alerts and location map setting not working
column6: During the full Admin Panel test, SOS alerts and the location map setting were found not working.
column7:
1. Trigger an SOS alert from the app during a trip
2. Check for the alert in the Admin Panel
3. Change the location map setting and check the apps
column8: SOS alerts should reach the Admin Panel, the map setting should apply in the apps, and admin and apps should stay in sync.
column9: SOS alerts and the map setting do not work.

column5: Parcels banner opens Rides instead of Parcels
column6: A banner linked to Parcels opens the Rides screen when its CTA is tapped.
column7:
1. In the Admin Panel, create a banner linked to Parcels
2. Open the Rider App Home Page
3. Tap the banner CTA
column8: The CTA should open Parcels.
column9: The Rides screen opens.

column5: "View All" links on the dashboard are not linked
column6: The View All links on the Admin dashboard do not navigate anywhere.
column7:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel
2. Click each "View All" link on the dashboard
column8: Each View All link should open its related page or section.
column9: Clicking the links does nothing.

column5: Surge pricing activates at the wrong times
column6: Surge pricing turns on outside the start/end times set in the Admin Panel. Example: Morning surge (8:00–9:30 AM) runs 5:00–6:30 AM, 3 hours early.
column7:
1. Configure surge slots in the Admin Panel (Morning 8:00–9:30 AM, Afternoon 12:00–1:30 PM, Rush Hour 4:00–5:30 PM, Night 8:00–9:30 PM)
2. Check surge status in both apps before, during and after each slot
column8: Surge should start and end exactly at the configured times in the Admin Panel time zone, follow schedule changes without code changes, and stay off outside the slots.
column9: Surge activates at wrong times (e.g. 5:00–6:30 AM instead of 8:00–9:30 AM).

column5: Mobile number updated in the Admin Panel does not show in the Rider App
column6: When an admin adds or changes a rider's mobile number, the new number does not appear in the Rider App.
column7:
1. In the Admin Panel, edit a rider's mobile number and save
2. Open the Rider App as that rider
3. Check the profile
column8: The updated number should be saved and shown in the rider's profile.
column9: The old / empty number is shown.

column6: Email notifications show lms.razinsoft@gmail.com as the sender.
column7:
1. Trigger any email notification (e.g. registration)
2. Check the From address of the received email
column8: The From address should be no-reply@iservu.app.
column9: The From address is lms.razinsoft@gmail.com.

column5: Weather Alert toggle does not hide alerts in the apps
column6: After turning Weather Alerts OFF in the Admin Panel, alerts still appear in the Rider and Driver apps.
column7:
1. Turn Weather Alerts OFF in the Admin Panel
2. Open and restart both apps
3. Check for weather alerts
column8: With the toggle OFF, alerts should disappear at once and not return after restart; they should show only when ON and conditions are met.
column9: Alerts still appear with the toggle OFF.

column5: AI Push Notifications sent several times a day without instruction
column6: AI Push Notifications set to send one morning notification per day to riders also send extra notifications at other times.
column7:
1. In AI Push Notifications, schedule one morning notification per day for riders
2. Monitor notifications received through the day
column8: Only the configured schedule, frequency and audience should be followed (one notification each morning).
column9: Extra notifications are sent during the day.

column5: Error when saving Sent.dm SMS provider settings
column6: Saving the SMS provider in the Admin Panel repeatedly returns an error. The client wants Sent.dm integrated (Sender ID: iSERVU, API URL: https://api.sent.dm/).
column7:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel
2. Open SMS Settings and choose Sent.dm
3. Enter the API key, Sender ID and API URL
4. Click Save
column8: Sent.dm settings should save and activate without errors, and SMS should go out through Sent.dm with the iSERVU Sender ID.
column9: An error is returned and the settings are not saved.

column5: Broadcast push notification fails with an error
column6: Sending a broadcast push notification from the Admin Panel returns an error and nothing is sent.
column7:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel
2. Open Broadcast
3. Compose a notification, choose recipients and send
column8: The broadcast should be sent to the selected group, once per recipient.
column9: An error is returned; nothing is sent.
